_comment: DDSD Mod Hub catalog, read by the launcher (Mods > Browse). Managed by the review bot (tools/modhub). Entries with 'download' are hosted here and install in one click; entries with only 'page' link to the mod's own site.

mods.name: Monika After Story
mods.author: The Monika After Story team
mods.description: Spend time with Monika after the story ends: talks, little games, music and lots of new moments. Cozy, long-running and open source.

mods.name: Doki Doki Do You Lift Club!
mods.author: CykaDev
mods.description: A comedy parody where you help the club members get ripped. Lots of memes (and some Russian swearing). Rated 12+ by its team.

mods.name: Doki Doki! RainClouds
mods.author: CykaDev
mods.description: DDLC's first act retold from Sayori's point of view, with new before- and after-school scenes. Heads up: it has heavy themes (16+).

mods.name: Doki Doki! New Eyes
mods.author: CykaDev
mods.description: Replay the club through Yuri's eyes: new scenes, backstory and 10+ hours of story. Heads up: it has heavy themes (16+).

mods.name: Doki Doki Blue Skies
mods.author: Blue Dissonance Development
mods.description: DDLC rebuilt as a proper romance visual novel, with full routes for Sayori, Yuri and Natsuki. Heads up: it deals with mental health, including depression and suicide.

mods.name: Salvation Remake
mods.author: 12gizguy6
mods.description: A very long Sayori story: you wake up the night before the festival and get a second chance to save her, and to help the others too. Friendship over romance. Heads up: it starts from a suicide attempt.

mods.name: Doki Doki Salvation
mods.author: 12gizguy6
mods.description: The original Salvation (2018): stop the tragedy at the end of Act 1 and deal with what comes after. Heads up: suicide is part of the story.

mods.name: Fallen Angel
mods.author: Noa_AT
mods.description: A Yuri romance where Monika isn't self-aware: get close to Yuri and help her through anxiety and insecurity. Warm, then very sad. Heads up: self-harm.

mods.name: A Slice of Life
mods.author: kmsrocks1 and ogsnakebone
mods.description: A short romance/comedy retelling where you get another chance to save the club. A lighter one to start with.
